title: Data of the event fact.rejected
description: A fact proposal of an attempt that the core refused: no record is created, only this event remains (MEM-6, spec/lifecycles/fact.md).

task.description: The task whose attempt proposed the fact.

predicate.description: The predicate of the proposal, when it had one.

reason.description: fact_insufficient: less evidence than min_samples, or a predicate the core does not derive in this version; output_schema_invalid: the proposal does not pass the schema, its kind or subject type does not fit the predicate, or it is over memory.facts.per_attempt; not_found: the subject is not an object of the tenant.
